name: sloane
description: Preview a personalized AI receptionist for your business

interface.longDescription:
Sloane is an AI receptionist for small businesses. It answers your business calls 24/7, books appointments, sends texts and emails, and captures customer information, all trained on your business.

This plugin generates a personalized receptionist greeting from your business website. Give it your website and Sloane scans the site to find your business name, contact details, services, and hours. It then writes the greeting Sloane would answer your calls with and creates an audio recording so you can hear exactly how your receptionist will sound.

When you're ready, follow the link to continue setting up Sloane with the business details it already found, so you don't have to enter them again.
defaultPrompt: Use Sloane to preview an AI receptionist for my business website.
Use Sloane to hear how an AI receptionist would answer calls for my business.

positive.description: Business owner asks for a receptionist preview using their website
positive.prompt: Show me what an AI receptionist would sound like for my business: https://www.poshpetcare.com
positive.expected_behavior: Calls preview_receptionist with the website URL and shows the business name, the details Sloane found, the greeting text, a link to the greeting audio, and the link to continue onboarding.

positive.description: User gives a bare domain without https
positive.prompt: Can Sloane answer the phone for poshpetcare.com? Give me a preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls preview_receptionist with the domain (the tool adds https://) and returns the personalized preview and onboarding link.

positive.description: User asks what greeting their callers would hear
positive.prompt: What would callers hear if Sloane answered for https://hi-sloane.com?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls preview_receptionist and presents the greeting text and greeting audio link for the business found on the site.

positive.description: User wants to see what Sloane learns from their website
positive.prompt: Scan my website https://www.poshpetcare.com and tell me what Sloane would know about my business.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls preview_receptionist and lists the business details found (phone numbers, email, address, services, hours, description) plus the greeting and onboarding link.

positive.description: User who misses calls asks to try an AI receptionist with their site
positive.prompt: I keep missing calls at my business. Set up a preview of an AI receptionist for https://www.poshpetcare.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls preview_receptionist and returns the preview with the link to continue setting up Sloane for that business.

negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Request to call a business on the user's behalf, which Sloane does not do
negative.prompt: Call my dentist and book me a cleaning for next Tuesday.

negative.description: Writing task about receptionists with no business website to preview
negative.prompt: Write a job description for a front desk receptionist at a law firm.
